## Publication safety check (required before any public release)

- [ ] No patient identifiers or re-identification details
- [ ] No confidential protocols, DSMB materials, internal emails, unpublished results, or collaborator discussions
- [ ] Examples are public, de-identified with clearance, or synthetic
- [ ] All figures, quotations, and citations are licensed/attributed appropriately
- [ ] Claims distinguish source evidence from interpretation
- [ ] Explicit site-owner approval obtained before release or deployment

**Reminder:** `draft: true` hides a rendered article, not its Git history if the repository later becomes public.
